name: Virtua Call 3
source:
Yoichi Asami was about to have another cold lonely summer vacation. One day he encounters a girl by chance and receives from her a cartridge called "Virtual Call" with which one can access a two-side videophone service. What kind relationship will he find there?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/08/vn-of-month-july-1997.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
浅见洋一原本又要迎来一个寒冷孤独的暑假。一天，他偶然遇见一名女孩，并从她手中得到名为‘Virtual Call’的卡带，可以借此使用双向可视电话服务。他会在那里建立怎样的关系？

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/08/vn-of-month-july-1997.html]vndbreview[/url]]
